method: Viewed source artwork, producer masks/contact sheets, independently extracted native-resolution motion crops and last-two/first-two frame pairs. Fully decoded all 84 frames of each video and independently recomputed adjacent-frame, seam, inside/outside-mask and brightness metrics. Verified SHA-256 before/after decode and at report writing.
limitations: No full-speed playback or audio audition performed.
Approval applies only to these exact visual hashes, not integrated product quality or production readiness.

scenes.scope: Exact-SHA sampled visuals and independent full-decode metrics; no full-speed playback or audio audition
findings: Viewed source artwork, producer mask/contact sheet, eight native-resolution stove and lantern samples, and the last-two/first-two stove frames. Stove metal, logs, sleeping cat, furniture, landscape, books and foreground objects preserve their geometry.

Fire flicker is clearly visible inside the stove and restrained inside the lantern. No evident rectangular mask edge, object duplication, or motion spill is visible in these samples. The pixel-art style remains consistent.

Independent full decode reproduces seam ratio 1.6713, below the unchanged threshold of 4; outside-mask change is 0.000241 on a 0–255 channel scale. Sampled seam flame changes resemble ordinary flicker.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed playback and audition integrated ambience.

scenes.scope: Exact-SHA sampled visuals and independent full-decode metrics; no full-speed playback or audio audition
findings: Viewed source artwork, producer mask/contact sheet, eight native-resolution waterfall/bridge/steam samples, and last-two/first-two frames. Bridge railings, architecture, foreground lamp, flowers and desk remain stable.

Motion is very restrained in the waterfall/steam region. Existing wisps and stone edges show no obvious duplicated edges or rectangular mask boundary in sampled frames. Much of the scene, including the sky and hanging lantern, intentionally remains still.

Independent full decode reproduces seam ratio 3.5289, below the unchanged threshold of 4 but relatively close to the limit; absolute seam change is only 0.05848 on a 0–255 channel scale. Sampled seam frames show no obvious framing or exposure jump. Repeated full-speed playback deserves attention because the short, subtle loop can conceal a perceptible reset.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed playback and audition integrated ambience.
